title: DrawWaveResponse
description: The wave's merge card and whether merge is offered, with the reason on the card when it is not.

card.description: The wave's merge card: the answer, each slice's block, then the wave's own lines.

lines.description: One line for each thing the card says, wrapped by the kernel to 44 columns.

mark.description: The line was worked out by script from a step that ran no skill.

words.description: What the owner reads, worked out by script.

step.description: The step of the wave that the line cites.

oneOf.description: A line worked out by script.

A line of judgement from inside a slice's item: the reviewer's, citing the review step under which the reviewer last ran, or the builder's, citing the round under which it last built; the kernel adds the skills and tiers of that step and the item.

mark.description: The line is a model's judgement, never a check.

words.description: The reviewer's verdict on a condition, a finding that remains or a practice it answered not held, in the reviewer's words; or what the builder says is missing, or a decision it made, in its words.

step.description: The review step the line cites, or the round under which the builder last built.

item.description: The slice's item in the foreach slices, counted from 0 in plan order.

merge.description: Why merge is withheld, as one sentence or more.

withheld.description: The reason for merge when it is withheld; empty when merge is offered.

merge.description: Offered only when at least one slice passed its own proof, every such slice merged cleanly into the combined head, and the wave's checks passed there.
